resources.string: A gentle elbows-off-the-table reminder for family meals.
Everything runs on this phone. No images or video are saved, nothing is uploaded, and nobody is identified.
Place the phone above head height at one corner of the table, looking down so every shoulder, elbow, wrist and the tabletop are visible.
This is a conservative helper, not a validated measurement. When it cannot see an elbow it stays quiet.
Set up the camera and mark the table once before monitoring.
Camera permission is needed to watch the table. Grant it when asked, or allow it in Android settings for this app.
The camera view changed, so the table outline no longer fits. Recalibrate the table, and do so whenever the phone is moved.
Check that shoulders, elbows and wrists of everyone, and the whole tabletop, are visible. Lines appear on detected people.
People: %1$d of %2$d · all arms visible in %3$d %% of frames · %4$.0f FPS · checked %5$.0f of 10 s
Everyone is visible. Continue with the table.

Checking for 10 seconds with everyone seated. If this does not pass, raise the phone or move it further away so every shoulder, elbow and wrist stays visible, avoid backlight, and keep bowls from hiding elbows.
Tap the four tabletop corners in order around the table. Only the visible camera image counts.
Waiting for the camera image. Try again in a moment.
Processing is slow (%1$.0f FPS). The Lite model in Settings may help.
This phone is too slow to monitor reliably right now (%1$.0f FPS). No warnings until it speeds up; try the Lite model in Settings.
Tap inside the camera image, not the empty margin.
Seat regions allowed: %1$d. Draw one around each place, four taps per seat. Seats keep assignments stable when people lean; seat numbers never identify anyone.
Seats: %1$d of %2$d. Corners of next seat: %3$d of 4
Seats must not overlap. Tap again.
Paused. No warnings until you resume.
False alarm noted. Reminders rest for %1$d s.
Waiting for a clear camera view. No warnings without fresh evidence.
%1$.1f FPS · latency p50 %2$d / p95 %3$d ms · dropped %4$d · model %5$s · thermal %6$s · battery %7$d %% · violations %8$d · mean joint confidence %9$.2f
SYNTHETIC DEMO · generated stick figures, not camera data. Sound and storage are off.
Seat 1 eats, reaches across and briefly hides an arm. Seat 2 rests an elbow for a few seconds, then corrects it.
Changing the camera clears the table outline. Changes apply to the next monitoring session.
Only feedback you press, opted-in session statistics and training-mode landmark logs are stored. Never images or video.
Delete every stored feedback and statistics record and every session log? This cannot be undone.
Saved: %1$s. Only feature numbers were stored, no image.

Training mode writes this session\'s body-landmark coordinates (never images) to a log on this phone. Tap a label when you see it happen; it is stored with the time and seat. Logs are for tuning and can be exported or deleted under Local data.
Session log storage is full. Not recorded: %1$s, seat %2$d. Export and delete logs.
Delete this session log? This cannot be undone.
